We launched Brain² last week and I need to talk about it from the Sales Leader side.

My Enterprise Sales org lives in the product every day: account plans, forecasts, deal strategy, customer prep, internal collaboration, etc.. Brain² changed how I operate in less than a week.

The difference isn't "we added AI." Every company added AI. The difference is context. 🧠 Brain² already knows my deals, my team's docs, our conversation history, every decision trail. I don't paste context into a chat window. I just ask.

One prompt gives me a forecast readout. Another builds me a customer-ready deck. I have AI agents that prep my team for calls, flag deal risk, and catch action items I missed in back-to-back meetings. ⚡

In blind head-to-head evals, users preferred Brain² 100% of the time over standalone ChatGPT and Claude on real work tasks. Not because the models are better (we use the same frontier models). Because context is the moat. 🏆

The model isn't the product. Your company's knowledge is. 🔑

If you're evaluating AI for your org, stop asking "which model?" and start asking "which platform actually knows how my team works?" That's ClickUp!

repost_content.text:
ClickUp just blew past $300M ARR. But we're not just celebrating a number.

We're stopping to celebrate the entire journey - before we move the goal post again.

And this journey has been nothing short of extraordinary. We’ve grown from a small team with a huge dream into a global company helping 20M+ people maximize their productivity.

7 years ago, we set out with an ambitious vision.

We built ClickUp to end the chaos of work sprawl and converge many software categories together. We started when "one app" was seen as the wrong strategy, but today it's the only strategy to realize our mission of making people more productive.

Because 100% context is the single most important thing for enabling human productivity from AI.

So, this milestone? We stop. We breathe. We practice gratitude. We celebrate.

To our customers: Thank you so much for believing in us, and for sticking with us through growing pains.

To our teams: I'm infinitely grateful for how much you care, it energizes me to keep going every single day.

We’re just getting started. Thank you to everyone who’s been part of this story. 💜
